description: Compute the next version for a release type (major, minor, patch, premajor, preminor, prepatch, prerelease, release), with an optional prerelease id such as alpha, beta or rc, exactly like npm version / semver.inc. Read-only: nothing is published. Same engine as GET /api/bump.

preid.description: Prerelease identifier, e.g. "beta" (for pre* and prerelease).

version.description: Current version: a semantic version such as "1.4.2", "v2.0.0" or "3.0.0-rc.1+build.5".

name: bump_version
title: Compute the next version
